idea-plugin.name: Markdown Lens
idea-plugin.description:
A polished, feature-rich Markdown preview that keeps up with your document as you edit.
  • GitHub Flavored Markdown with tables, task lists, strikethrough, and syntax-highlighted code blocks.
  • Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX math for rich technical documentation.
  • Interactive zoom and pan controls for diagrams and standalone images.
  • Automatic table of contents, in-document anchor navigation, and clickable project file paths.
  • YAML and TOML frontmatter presented as clean, collapsible metadata.
  • Editor-synchronized scrolling for effortless navigation between source and preview.
  • Light and dark themes with adjustable preview font size.
